_meta.description: Locked client training hyperparameters per exec mode. Both modes use the SAME model architecture (Net: 45→64→Dropout(0.3)→32→Dropout(0.3)→2, ReLU, CrossEntropyLoss). Phase 2 P2.7 validated on 4 held-out dev seeds.
_meta.architecture_note: Architecture unified 2026-04-17. Previous version used SzelagNet for persistent-opt (invalidated — was a confounding variable). SzelagNet preserved ONLY in reproduce_szelag_v2.py (BRFSS Track A anchor).
_meta.grid_size: 160 combos per mode (5 lr × 4 epochs × 4 batch × 2 weight_decay)
_meta.szelag_anchor_check: P2.8 PASS — acc 0.5038 vs 0.504 target (BRFSS, SzelagNet, wd=0, Δ=0.0002)

persistent_optimizer.notes: Same architecture as Flower (Net). Persistent-opt outperforms Flower by ~0.8% because Adam momentum accumulates useful gradient info. Only lr differs (0.001 vs 0.005) — persistent momentum needs smaller steps.
